title: oldenlandia capitellata var. pubescens
intro: Oldenlandia capitellata var. pubescens, commonly known as Rough-haired Oldenlandia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in Asian cultures, for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Rough-haired Oldenlandia include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antipyretic effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
